en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard depicting an urban street scene with 19th-century European buildings, a tree in the foreground, and a quiet street extending into the distance. In the top right corner, the word 'Uppsala' is printed, and at the bottom, 'Skolgatan' and handwritten text are present. There is also faint text along the left side and a number at the bottom right.
